output.summary_en: A forwarded message in Tamil claims that drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice can kill or cure the coronavirus. It urges users to share the advice with everyone.

claims.claim_en: Drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice kills or cures the coronavirus.
